svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: HR Chat Agent solution architecture: employee requests pass through FastAPI security, a LangGraph agent with guard, scope check, tools and human approval, backed by PostgreSQL with pgvector and Gemini
svg.text: Agentic HR assistant for authenticated Ideas2IT employees · LangGraph · FastAPI · PostgreSQL + pgvector · Gemini (configurable)
Policy PDFs and .env never in git
Ideas2IT trust boundary · Docker Compose (local-first; container-ready for AWS)
Google OIDC verify · signed hd claim
Identity is taken only from the session and passed in run config — never chosen by the model
Checkpointer (Postgres): thread = employee_id:thread_id → multi-turn context; pending approvals survive restarts
Resilience: 90 s turn timeout · model retry + fallback reply · history trimmed to 24 messages
Tool layer · plain async Python, Pydantic-validated, identity injected (ToolContext)
